description: This Java source file defines the JavaScriptTemplateEngine class, which implements a template engine for processing JavaScript templates within the MockServer framework. It manages script compilation, execution, and validation, integrating Nashorn JavaScript engine with Java code.

classes.name: JavaScriptTemplateEngine
classes.description: Implements a template engine that executes JavaScript templates using Nashorn engine, with methods for template execution, validation, and script wrapping.

classes.name: DisallowClassesInTemplates
classes.description: A class filter that restricts certain Java classes from being exposed to JavaScript templates based on configuration.

methods.name: JavaScriptTemplateEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JavaScript engine, logger, deserializer, and configuration.

methods.name: executeTemplate
methods.description: Executes a JavaScript template against an HttpRequest, returning a deserialized DTO object.

methods.name: wrapTemplate
methods.description: Wraps a template string into a JavaScript function named handle.

methods.name: validateTemplate
methods.description: Checks the template for disallowed strings based on configuration.
